test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Though Kalpana listened to Sheetal carefully, she knew that she should __take it with a grain of salt. __

options.text: accept it as really useful and worthy
regard it as exaggerated and not completely true
be do it meticulously as taking salt

solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"take it with a grain of salt"** means to consider something as exaggerated or not completely true. (इसे नमक के दाने के साथ लेना) • **Example: **When John told me about his adventures, I **took it with a grain of salt **because he tends to exaggerate. • **"regard it as exaggerated and not completely true"** means to view something with skepticism or doubt. (इसे बढ़ा-चढ़ा कर और पूरी तरह से सच नहीं मानना) • **Example: **She took his promises with a grain of salt, knowing his history of breaking them. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. regard it as exaggerated and not completely true. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **accept it as really useful and worthy** (इसे वास्तव में उपयोगी और योग्य मानें): To consider something as beneficial and valuable. • **Example:** She accepted his advice as really useful and worthy of consideration. • **move according to the trend** (रुझान के अनुसार चलना): To act or make decisions based on current popular trends. • **Example: **He decided to move according to the trend and invest in cryptocurrency. • **be do it meticulously as taking salt** (इसे नमक की तरह सावधानीपूर्वक करें): This option is incorrect and does not convey a meaningful phrase. • **Example:** This option is not valid as it does not make sense contextually. ``` 2e7:Tc28, The correct answer is **Option 1)**
